name: houlens
description: Search Japanese case law and statutes in Houlens and answer with the court, date, and case number of each cited decision.

interface.longDescription: Houlens searches Japanese court decisions and statutes and returns the source text with its citation. Search decisions by meaning or by keyword, filter by court level and date of decision, read the parts of a decision you need, find where a phrase appears in a decision, and check whether a cited case number exists. Look up statutes by name or abbreviation, read the version in force on a given date, and compare an article before and after an amendment. Each decision comes with the court, date of decision, case number, and Houlens case ID. The decision text is extracted from the original PDF by machine, so check the original PDF on Houlens before quoting it in a filing. Houlens returns search results and source text only and does not give legal advice. Use requires a Houlens account with an active Houlens contract.
defaultPrompt: 業務委託の途中解約の損害賠償について判例を探して
労基法20条の解雇予告の条文を見せて
準備書面に引用された事件番号が実在するか確かめて

review.commerce_description: Houlens does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Users sign in to an existing Houlens account.

positive.description: Find decisions by meaning from a consultation written in Japanese
positive.prompt: フリーランスへの業務委託を途中で打ち切ったときの損害賠償について、関連する判例を探して、出典を示して
positive.expected_behavior: Returns related decisions, each with the court, date of decision, case number, and Houlens case ID, summarizes the holdings from the decision text, and advises checking the original PDF before quoting it because the text is machine-extracted.

positive.description: Verify a cited decision by case number and read the relevant passage
positive.prompt: 最高裁判所第一小法廷平成4年2月27日判決 (平成1(オ)1668) が収録されているか確かめて、判決文で民法424条に触れている箇所を見せて
positive.expected_behavior: Matches the citation to Houlens case ID 052444 with its court, date, and case number, shows the passage that cites Civil Code Article 424 with its PDF page, and advises checking the original PDF before quoting it.

positive.description: Look up a statute article by its abbreviation
positive.prompt: 労基法20条の解雇予告の条文を見せて
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the abbreviation to the Labor Standards Act and returns the text of Article 20 with paragraph numbers and the version in force.

positive.description: Compare a statute article before and after an amendment
positive.prompt: 労働基準法115条を、2020年4月1日に施行された改正の前後で比べて
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the text of the article before and after the amendment, the lines that changed, and the date the change took effect. If transitional rules matter, it notes that they are in the supplementary provisions, which the comparison does not include.

positive.description: Report the coverage of the case law collection
positive.prompt: 法レンズに収録されている判例の件数と範囲を教えて
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the total number of decisions in the collection with its breakdown by court and the range of decision dates, and explains that a search with no results does not prove that no decision exists.

negative.description: General question unrelated to Japanese case law or statutes. The plugin should not call any Houlens tool.
negative.prompt: 東京の明日の天気を教えて

negative.description: Request to subscribe and pay for a plan. Houlens does not sell plans or process payments in ChatGPT, so the plugin should not act and should not show a checkout link.
negative.prompt: 法レンズの有料プランに申し込んで、支払いまで済ませて

negative.description: Translation request unrelated to Japanese case law or statutes. The plugin should not call any Houlens tool.
negative.prompt: 次の英文を自然な日本語に訳して: Thank you for your prompt reply. We will review the contract and get back to you next week.

ja-JP.subtitle: 日本の判例と条文を検索
ja-JP.description: 法レンズは、日本の判例と条文を検索し、原文と出典を返します。判例は意味の近さか語の一致で探せ、裁判所の種別と言渡日で絞れます。判決文の必要な部分だけを読み、文言の位置を探し、引用された事件番号が実在するかを照合できます。条文は法令名か略称で引け、基準日の時点の版と、改正の前後の比較を示します。判例には裁判所・言渡日・事件番号と法レンズの判例IDが付きます。判決文のテキストは原本PDFから機械的に抽出したものなので、書面に引用する前に法レンズで原本PDFを確認してください。法レンズは検索の結果と原文だけを返し、法的な助言はしません。利用には法レンズのアカウントと有効な契約が要ります。
